description: Sound effects from a text prompt (English or Chinese), up to 30 s at 48 kHz. Environmental, urban, creature and human-action sounds.
cpuNote: Slow on the CPU: every effect denoises a full 30 s latent, so expect minutes per effect. Fewer diffusion steps help.

settings.label: Diffusion steps
settings.description: Fewer steps are faster; 100 is the upstream default.

settings.label: CFG scale
settings.description: How strictly the sound follows the prompt.
